For some reason, something has changed in the EXTHUK, EXTBAS, 
or EXT<mumble> files since about midsummer, and caused that
read-time-expansion of an SI:XREF to lose again.  I've implemented
the crock in a different way so as not to depend on these
continuing vagaries, and recompiled DEFVSX (now version 105).
Sigh!  Can anyone think of why the read-time expansion suddenly
changed from going into a RPLACX into a (LAMBDA ... (RPLACX ...)) ?
